title: Nerve block anesthesia
what: The anesthetist injects near a nerve, and your arm or leg goes numb. Surgery can be done without general anesthesia, and there is less pain afterward.
why: For surgery on the arm, shoulder, leg, or foot, and for pain relief after surgery.
duration: the injection usually takes 10 to 20 minutes; numbness lasts several hours, sometimes up to a day
tell_doctor: Blood thinners. Do not stop them on your own. Your doctor will decide
Past numbness or weakness in this limb
Lung conditions. This matters for a block near the neck

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: Usually the same rules as before surgery. The clinic will tell you when to stop eating and drinking.

prepare.title: Anesthetist
prepare.text: Tell the anesthetist about your health. You can ask for sedation to doze.

prepare.title: Getting home
prepare.text: Arrange a ride home. Your arm or leg will still be numb.

steps: An IV line is placed, and you are connected to monitors
Sometimes you get a sedative to relax
The skin is cleaned and numbed
Using ultrasound, the doctor guides a thin needle near the nerve
The medicine is injected, and the limb gets warm and numb
Once the numbness is complete, surgery begins
feel: The injection feels like a regular shot, brief
Warmth and tingling, then heaviness and numbness
During surgery, touch but no pain. If it hurts, say so right away
after: While the limb is numb, protect it: keep it away from heat, do not lean on it
Keep your arm in a sling, and do not put weight on your leg without support
Start painkillers on schedule before the numbness wears off
Feeling usually comes back after a few hours or by morning
red_flags: Numbness or weakness lasts more than a day
Shortness of breath or chest pain after a block near the neck: call emergency services
Ringing in the ears, a metallic taste, or seizures: tell a doctor right away or call emergency services

faq.a: You can stay awake, or doze under sedation. Discuss it with the anesthetist.

faq.q: Why can't I move my arm after surgery?
faq.a: That is how the block works. Movement will come back when the medicine wears off.

reminders.text: Surgery with a nerve block tomorrow. Eat and drink only until the time the clinic gave you. Arrange a ride home.
